paper_metadata.title: Stress corrosion cracking of high strength stainless steels for use as strand in prestressed marine environment concrete construction

evidence.quote: The alloys tested were a common austenitic stainless steel with high nickel content UNS # S31603, UNS# S24000, and a duplex stainless steel with high chromium and an additional constituent, molybdenum UNS# S32205.
This investigation examined the SCC performance of a manganese substitute austenitic stainless steel alloy, as compared to a 300 series austenitic stainless steel alloy, and a duplex stainless steel.
